results.rationale: Consistency: the cream handbag retains its arched black-edged handle, attachment tabs, gold double-G clasp, chevron flap stitching and curved lower quilting; the background, scale, placement and lighting changes are requested. Instruction: the edit creates a softly lit gray gradient advertisement with ample space and gold lettering. The expected image requires a slightly right-of-center bag, exact upper-left copy and bottom-center GUCCI. The bag is substantially rightward, the headline is garbled instead of Elegance, Always., and GUCCI sits at bottom left; partial compliance. Quality: structure, product texture and shadow logic are coherent (✔), but the visibly nonsensical headline is a clear semantic artifact (✘).

Consistency: the two chocolate-coated cookie identities and leaning arrangement remain recognizable, excluding requested setting, lighting and viewpoint changes. However, the prominent crack across the upper cookie disappears and the caramel drizzle paths are redrawn, including a large arch on the lower cookie; multiple non-requested surface details change. Instruction: the white setting becomes brown velvet with a black slate base, warm upper-left illumination and centered cookies. The expected display also needs an upward viewpoint and the exact supplied upper-right sentence. The edit provides the setting and title placement, but its title is largely nonsensical and the view still looks down onto the cookie tops and slate; partial compliance. Quality: coherent cookies, cloth folds, slate texture and lighting (✔), with a conspicuous garbled text block as a semantic flaw (✘).
